title: EDI Analyst
jobDescription:
Job Title: EDI Analyst Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan (On-Site) Shift Timings: Night Shift Education Criteria: Btech/ BCA/ Mtech/ MCA or any other computers degree or diploma Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Monitor EDI transactions to ensure successful data exchanges and troubleshoot any errors or issues. Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to facilitate smooth EDI communications. Support the mapping and translation of data between various formats Help to develop and maintain EDI documentation, including process flows and mapping specifications.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Basic understanding of EDI concepts and standards. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and organizational abilities. Proficiency in MS-Excel.

title: Senior System Administrator
jobDescription: Job Title: Network & System Administrator Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain network infrastructure, including Cisco switches, Sonic Wall firewalls, Ruckus Wi-Fi, ISP connectivity, and network security. Administer Windows, Ubuntu, mac OS, Active Directory, cloud domain controllers, file servers, and endpoint security solutions. Manage Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, MDM (Scalefusion/Intune), DLP, MFA, PAM, and endpoint protection platforms. Monitor network, server, and security performance; troubleshoot connectivity, VPN, AWS Workspace, RDP, and encryption-related issues. Perform system updates, patch management, vulnerability remediation, backups, and disaster recovery activities. Maintain IT assets, documentation, operational reports, and compliance-ready records. Support ISO 27001, SOC 2, VAPT, and other audit requirements, including evidence collection and remediation tracking. Monitor SIEM tools, conduct log reviews, support incident response, and enforce security policies and best practices. Participate in change management, business continuity (BCP), and disaster recovery (DR) planning and testing. Lead infrastructure projects, vendor evaluations, capacity planning, and continuous improvement initiatives. Provide technical support, user training, and ensure adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs). Preferred Skills Hands-on experience with Cisco switches, Sonic Wall firewalls, Ruckus Wi-Fi, Active Directory, M365, and Google Workspace. Strong understanding of networking, routing, VLANs, firewalls, and cybersecurity principles. Experience with SIEM, vulnerability management, ITSM, MDM, and DLP solutions. Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware/Hyper-V) and automation tools (Power Shell). Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent are preferred.

title: Admin Executive
jobDescription: We are looking for a highly organized and resourceful Admin Executive with proven experience in managing end-to-end office administration. The ideal candidate will take ownership of administrative operations, vendor coordination, travel management, facility upkeep, and employee lifecycle support, ensuring smooth and efficient workplace functioning. Key Responsibilities Independently manage domestic and international travel arrangements , including flights, accommodations, ground transport, and visa coordination Oversee day-to-day office administration and ensure seamless operational support across departments Maintain and monitor office inventory (stationery, pantry supplies, IT assets, and equipment) with timely planning and restocking Source, evaluate, and coordinate with vendors and service providers for procurement of office supplies, IT equipment, and facility-related services Support employee onboarding and offboarding processes , including ID card issuance, access management, workspace readiness, and documentation Assist in planning and executing internal events, meetings, leadership visits, and employee engagement initiatives Act as the primary point of contact for facility management , ensuring proper upkeep, maintenance, and housekeeping standards Maintain accurate documentation and records related to procurement, travel bookings, vendor contracts, and employee movements Ensure compliance with internal administrative policies and help streamline processes for improved efficiency Provide proactive administrative and operational support to internal teams and leadership as required
